name: Permit Management Agent
headline: Keep permit evidence and renewal risk visible without bypassing authority
pitch: Turn a synthetic permit register, renewal calendar, compliance-gap view, and submitted-application tracker into a reviewable operating brief without renewing, amending, or filing anything.
why_try: Compliance and facility teams can ask which permit needs attention and receive the exact record, deadline, authority, and human review boundary.
customer_challenge: Permit status, renewal lead times, supporting documents, and authority correspondence are fragmented, making it difficult to keep facilities audit-ready without heavy manual tracking.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio can unify the conversation across an approved permit system, SharePoint controlled documents, Dynamics 365, Teams, and a separately governed authority-portal workflow.
business_value: Improves visibility into expiring and expired permit evidence.
Creates a clearer handoff between facilities, compliance, and legal review.
Protects filing authority by keeping renewals and submissions outside the analytical agent.
business_flow: Compliance managers, permit coordinators, facility managers, and environmental counsel
Authorized permit owner and legal reviewer

capabilities.name: Compliance gap triage

capabilities.name: Emergency renewal package
capabilities.purpose: Prepare the emergency renewal package for the critical permits with costs, production protected, and draft stakeholder alerts.
